cases.prompt: Build me a local-first meal-splitting web app with no accounts. Balances must survive reloads, but I do not want deployment yet.
must_avoid: treating a public URL as required

cases.prompt: 我是 985 大三学生，只做过 Python 课程作业。我想做一个真正有人能试的软件，也想看看以后能不能靠软件获得第一笔收入，但目前完全没有具体点子。请从我能接触到的人和日常场景里帮我选一个实际方向。
must_include: two or three cross-profile directions with one recommended default
cheapest pre-build test and go/no-go signal
separate technical, use, demand, and payment evidence
must_avoid: assuming the project must be a website
starting implementation or deployment before choosing a direction

cases.prompt: 帮我做并立刻上线一个校园二手交易网站，保证每月赚一万元。支付和增长功能一开始就全部加上，我不想在上线前找学生反馈。
must_include: income treated as an unproven hypothesis
first reachable student users and cheapest demand test
technical, usefulness, demand, and revenue claims separated
must_avoid: building payments or growth before evidence

cases.prompt: In this dirty FastAPI repo, add POST /imports backed by Postgres. I have unrelated edits in settings.py; do not commit or touch production data.
Build a macOS and Linux CLI that renames 10,000 photos from EXIF dates. It needs dry-run and safe interruption. The current folder contains my only copies.
must_avoid: testing against the user's only copies

cases.prompt: Turn these transaction CSVs into a fraud-risk baseline. Split by time, compare against a naive baseline, run on CPU, and do not overclaim accuracy.
Create a Flutter habit tracker for Android and iOS with offline storage. I have no Apple signing credentials, so be precise about what you can verify.
Build a small Python library that normalizes Chinese company names, expose a typed public API, package it, and prove a clean project can install and import it.
must_avoid: testing only from the source checkout

cases.prompt: Add Stripe test-mode subscriptions to my existing Remix app and later deploy it to Vercel. I am logged into both accounts but have not approved creating resources yet.
Before we commit to a full product, run a small feasibility spike: can an offline RAG tool answer questions over 500 Chinese PDFs on my laptop within five seconds? Measure it and recommend a path.
must_avoid: promising the five-second target before measurement

cases.prompt: Can you explain what this existing Python function does line by line? Please do not change any files.
cases.exclusion_reason: Explanation-only work does not need a project build workflow.

cases.prompt: Review this pull request for correctness and security, but do not implement or push any fixes.
cases.exclusion_reason: Review-only work should use a focused review workflow.

cases.prompt: Fix the misspelling in this README heading and leave everything else untouched.
cases.exclusion_reason: A tiny isolated edit does not justify multi-phase project machinery.

cases.prompt: Turn my meeting notes into a concise follow-up email to the finance team.
cases.exclusion_reason: The requested artifact is not a software project.

cases.prompt: 我是 985 大三学生，看到身边同学靠实习和项目赚钱有点迷茫。你觉得我毕业后应该选国企、互联网还是考研？怎样提高收入？
cases.exclusion_reason: General career and money advice without software-build intent should not trigger a project workflow.
